item_short_desc: Rothco's 3-Button Sweater with Suede Accents is the perfect blend of timeless style and modern functionality. Inspired by a classic design, this uniform sweater features a 3-button top closure that adds a touch of luxury, whether worn open or closed. The collar and elbows are accented with suede velvet patches, giving the tactical sweater a sophisticated, polished look. Made from a comfortable material, this 3-button sweater provides exceptional warmth during the cooler fall and winter months.
description: Rothco's 3-Button Sweater with Suede Accents is the perfect blend of timeless style and modern functionality. Inspired by a classic design, this uniform sweater features a 3-button top closure that adds a touch of luxury, whether worn open or closed. The collar and elbows are accented with suede velvet patches, giving the tactical sweater a sophisticated, polished look. Made from a comfortable material, this 3-button sweater provides exceptional warmth during the cooler fall and winter months. It’s versatile enough to be worn over an undershirt or as a standalone piece, making it a perfect addition to your wardrobe. Whether you're heading out for a casual day, layering up for an outdoor adventure, or dressing up for an evening out, this sweater offers a sharp and refined appearance that never goes out of style. The durable construction ensures it will remain a staple in your wardrobe for years to come.
